name: Brand Monopolist
description: Make your soft drink a household name in three cities. With no rival company in the way, the competition is the local incumbents and the cost of keeping a brand alive: awareness fades every month you stop paying for it.

goals.description: Reach 70 brand awareness for soft drinks in Metropolis.
Reach 70 brand awareness for soft drinks in Eastside.
Reach 70 brand awareness for soft drinks in Riverside.
